privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: You control your data at any time. Pick one of the actions below.
privacy.deleteConvsBody: Removes the chat history and the associated checkpoints. Your account stays active.
privacy.deleteAccountBody: Deletes conversations, name, e-mail and password. Unlinks your establishment (the establishment data stays because it is not yours). The audit trail is kept, pseudonymised.
privacy.confirmHelp: This action only runs when the text matches {{word}}.

history.title: Your conversations
history.emptyBody: Start a conversation to see it listed here.

queue.title: Handoff queue
queue.emptyBody: No tickets waiting for an agent.

ticket.title: Ticket detail
ticket.loading: Open the ticket from the queue to load its context.
ticket.pendingActionBody: The merchant asked for an action that needs operator approval: {{type}}.
ticket.missingDecision: Choose approve or reject before sending.
ticket.replyPlaceholder: Explain what was done or the next step
ticket.alreadyClosed: This ticket has already been closed.

home.title: Administration
